questions.descriptionEn: Contactor measurement step question (Step_6); the question stem is given by the project side, the options follow the A/B/C/D order, and the correct answer is C. questions.description: 接触器测量步骤题（Step_6b）；题干由项目方给定，原稿的 O/0 按 Ω 归一（8500 → 850Ω），正确答案 A。注：C/D 本身是自洽的解释规则，故题干写成“本次测量的结果及判断”，以 A 为唯一正确项。
questions.questionText: 用万用表测量接触器线圈 A1-A2 的电阻，本次测量的结果及判断是（  ）。

options.itemText: 线圈电阻在 850Ω 左右，线圈正常

options.itemText: 线圈电阻在 850kΩ 左右，线圈正常
options.itemTextEn: The coil resistance is about 850 kΩ, so the coil is normal
The coil resistance is 0, so the coil is short-circuited

options.itemText: 线圈电阻无穷大，线圈开路
options.itemTextEn: The coil resistance is infinite, so the coil is open-circuited

questions.descriptionEn: Contactor measurement step question (Step_6b); the question stem is given by the project side, the O/0 in the original draft is normalized to Ω (8500 -> 850 Ω), and the correct answer is A. Note: C and D are self-consistent interpretation rules in themselves, so the question stem is written as the result and judgement of this measurement, making A the only correct option.
